name: social-publish-kit
description: Social-writing and image-generation skills with a local browser workflow for drafting, validating, and optionally publishing Threads, Facebook, and LinkedIn posts.

interface.shortDescription: Draft posts, render images, and publish with review gates.
interface.longDescription: A portable skill bundle for turning canonical source notes into Threads, Facebook, and LinkedIn drafts, cross-checking facts, proofreading Traditional Chinese, generating social image prompts, rendering PNGs through Codex or Gemini backends, and running a gated local browser publishing workflow.
defaultPrompt: Turn this source note into social drafts.
Render these carousel prompts as PNG files.
